snippet.title: NIGHTMARE SUPERHIGHWAY | Atmospheric Retro Liminal Space Game
snippet.description:
Awesome New Backrooms Game | BACKROOMS LIMINAL ESCAPE | PC
#liminalspace #retro #atmospheric #gameplay #gaming 

Buy Game - https://korkskrew2000.itch.io/nightmare-superhighway

CONGRATULATIONS, REGARDLESS IF YOU ENTERED OR NOT, YOU HAVE WON AN ALL (OR AT LEAST SOME) EXPENSES PAID VACATION TO THE NIGHTMARE SUPERHIGHWAY. DURING YOUR TRIP YOU CAN:

EXPLORE SEVERAL DETAILED MAPS
SEE TONS OF ORIGINAL MODELS AND TEXTURES MADE FROM SCRATCH
GET YOUR CARDIO IN
SEE YOUR WORLD SLOWLY CRUMBLE AT THE SEAMS AS REALITY TEARS ITSELF APART
THIS IS NOT A RACING GAME, DESPITE WHAT SOME UNSCRUPULOUS WEBSITES MAY CLAIM.

CONTROLS
TO LOOK AROUND, LOOK AROUND
WASD TO MOVE
LEFT CLICK TO INTERACT (RIGHT CLICK TO THROW IF HOLDING AN OBJECT)
SPACE TO JUMP
SHIFT TO SPRINT
